actions.reason: Cache the dense decode lookup structures on tokenizer instances when the vocabulary and special-token mappings are unchanged. Repeated decodes with the same tokenizer reuse the existing list instead of rebuilding it each call, while changes to the dictionaries invalidate the cache via their item tuples.
